body_markdown:
NEW YORK, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —[GPGI, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=IUAA0o1TRLl1CsLZvWo-yzqlkmC5MSBVUSXr2FeU1aNO3YkuNRgi_mJFNq0SfXAE_zFGpePcKeiOf-WCtMRjrA==) (NYSE: GPGI), a diversified multi-industry platform for companies with great positions in good industries, today announced it will host a conference call on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Standard Time (EST) to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. GPGI’s earnings results will be reported in a press release prior to the call.


GPGI’s leadership team will host the conference call, followed by a question-and-answer session.


**Date:** Thursday, November 5, 2026
**Time:** 8:00 a.m. EST
**Live webcast registration link:**[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Tmtl3VhxyPo0Sk9TMKV0yRo-verj6AaqqIfbiSHDbOld3-RPSTaE8UoJpAnt96udA91afU14x8joIdj7wJ7W63x51EsK39NY3ax9Jgox6Z4=)


We encourage all participants to register at least 15 minutes prior to the 8:00 a.m. EST start time. A live webcast and replay will be available on GPGI’s website at[https://gpgi.com/events-presentations/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=JHt2k9cV5Ozq0GRGxZyMLIoLf99vjFwlgnXswv0kBy64L5y-Qy08YbEbNaWYe0vwKt6kj-x7hkHIOPLZZlLS7P35llAhaxmqMWqT8bzyPMkZhHHzBx0YFsjz0cINzUUC4P9Mk24A-EK4GMGpS0HRaA==) . If you have any difficulty registering for the conference call, please contact GPGI at[ir@gpgi.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0o9sGNxbgzowRcFMwZLi7jrcRF-8QPwxQ_D5lNIyIrtIfiqSRNM_bav_zGbEcmdoinTOjm2S-BK0gOD12eqXzQ==) .


**About GPGI**


GPGI, Inc. (NYSE: GPGI) is a diversified, multi-industry platform for companies with great positions in good industries. The platform is managed by Resolute Holdings Management, Inc. (NYSE: RHLD) and is purpose-built to acquire, own, and scale high-quality businesses led by great operators, benefiting from a permanent capital base and the systematic deployment of the Resolute Operating System. GPGI currently consists of CompoSecure and Husky – two market leaders with best-in-class financials and durable opportunities for growth. For more information, please visit[GPGI.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=oiudGbEAv4G5hct7EsECHwA93RSVEfT00A9bDK-NDrw946OLyPqQuzxjSyhjgemFUefpxJ-5sdR2R-01rdG9iA==) .
